description: Tiny 刷怪农场社区版 — 紧凑的自动化刷怪/生物农场模组（Minecraft 1.12.2）

releases.notes:
## 中文

本次 `1.0.9-beta` 发布优化了外部配置热重载。配置文件检查间隔由 20 tick 调整为 200 tick（正常 TPS 下约 10 秒），并将两次文件属性查询合并为一次 NIO 属性读取，显著减少主线程文件系统调用。

同时修复了单人游戏中客户端 Tick 与集成服务端 Tick 共用计数器引起的重复检查和跨线程竞争。客户端与独立服务端现在各自只使用符合物理端的一条轮询路径。配置界面修改仍会立即同步，外部修改配置文件后仍会自动重载。

## English

This `1.0.9-beta` release optimizes external config hot reloads. File polling now runs every 200 ticks instead of every 20 ticks, approximately once every 10 seconds at normal TPS, and two file metadata calls have been consolidated into one NIO attribute read to reduce main-thread filesystem access.

It also fixes duplicate polling and a shared-counter race between client ticks and integrated-server ticks. Physical clients and dedicated servers now use only their appropriate polling path. Config-screen changes still synchronize immediately, and external file edits are still reloaded automatically.

mods.name: Tiny Mob Farm CE
mods.description: Adds compact single-block mob farms that generate mob drops passively.

releases.notes:
## 中文

本次 `1.0.8-beta` 同时覆盖 1.12.2 社区版与 Forge 1.16.5 beta 版。

1.16.5 移植版已同步 1.12.2 社区版的核心功能进度，包括 CraftTweaker 自定义产物、输出满暂停、输出失败重试、掉落来源缓存、机械农场、邻居方块变化重新检测，以及农场方块/物品形态渲染修正。

1.12.2 版本继续保留本次俄语本地化修正，提升俄语玩家的界面可读性和翻译完整度。

感谢社区贡献者 Yaroslavik / MrKoteo 提供俄语翻译更新。

## English

This `1.0.8-beta` release now covers both the 1.12.2 community build and the Forge 1.16.5 beta build.

The 1.16.5 port is aligned with the 1.12.2 community feature set, including CraftTweaker custom drops, output-full pausing, output retry handling, drop-source caching, mechanical farms, neighbor-change output rechecks, and farm block/item rendering fixes.

The 1.12.2 build keeps the Russian localization fixes, improving UI readability and translation coverage for Russian-speaking players.

Thanks to community contributor Yaroslavik / MrKoteo for the Russian translation update.

## 中文
本次发布为 Tiny Mob Farm CE 增加 CraftTweaker 自定义掉落支持。整合包可以按生物注册名添加、移除和清空自定义产物规则；支持单物品、物品数组、固定概率、概率范围和数量区间。命中 CraftTweaker 规则后会替代原版战利品表产物，未命中时仍回退到原有战利品表逻辑。

农场输出逻辑也进行了优化：输出满时会保留待输出产物，并按新的 `Output Retry Interval Ticks` 配置间隔重试，默认 20 tick，范围 1 到 3600 tick。产物在输出前会先合并可堆叠物品，减少相邻容器模拟和插入压力。掉落来源现在会缓存，套索槽和 CraftTweaker 规则未变化时不会重复解析。

## English
This release adds CraftTweaker custom drop support to Tiny Mob Farm CE. Modpacks can add, remove, and clear mob-specific custom drop rules by mob registry name, with support for single items, item arrays, fixed chances, chance ranges, and amount ranges. When a CraftTweaker rule matches, it replaces the vanilla loot table output; otherwise, the original loot table behavior is preserved.

The farm output flow has also been optimized. When output inventories are full, pending drops are retained and retried using the new `Output Retry Interval Ticks` config option, defaulting to 20 ticks with a valid range of 1 to 3600 ticks. Drops are compacted before output to reduce inventory simulation and insertion overhead. Drop sources are now cached so unchanged lasso slots and CraftTweaker rules do not trigger repeated source parsing.
